A ki bhujayein chhoti hain, B ki lambi, par tester rakho toh dono par bilkul fit hoga: dono barabar. Board par do angle dekho: ek ki bhujayein 6 cm, doosre ki 12 cm. Kaunsa zyada khula hai?

Darwaza thoda kholo toh angle chhota, aur zyada kholo toh angle bada ho jaata hai. Board par ek gate hai jo 2 m chauda hai, aur ek darwaza jo 1 m chauda hai; dono khule hain. Kiska angle bada hai, ya dono barabar hain?

Rani ki rangoli mein teen kone hain, P, Q aur R, aur P ki bhujayein sabse lambi hain. Hamein inmein sabse bada angle dhoondhna hai. Pehle P ko lo: uska khulna right angle se kam hai ya zyada?
